note: Hand-maintained leads and resource links. Leads are unverified starting points.

leads.title: Alignerr: AI training and coding evaluation
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Technical model evaluation, coding and writing tasks.

leads.title: Outlier: prompt writing and response evaluation
leads.location: Remote (Sweden listed in published country policy)
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Project-based evaluation, ranking and coding tasks; projects require qualification assessments.

leads.title: micro1: AI evaluation and technical specialists
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Technical AI assessment and model training roles with interviews.

leads.title: DataAnnotation: coding and reasoning evaluation
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Coding, reasoning and writing evaluation.
leads.eligibilityNote: A Sweden restriction was reported (unverified; check the source)

leads.title: TELUS Digital AI Community
leads.location: Remote (international; language projects may include Swedish)
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Data annotation, search evaluation and language quality projects.

leads.title: OneForma: multilingual AI data projects
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Multilingual data, transcription, evaluation and data collection.

leads.title: Surge AI: human feedback and specialist data work
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Human feedback and specialist data work; allowed regions not known.

leads.title: AfterQuery: specialist evaluation and AI training
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Find the official site before applying.

leads.title: Prolific: research studies including AI evaluations
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Paid research participation, sometimes testing or comparing AI systems.

leads.title: OpenAI OpenWorks pilot
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Individuals and small teams applying with a real problem solved using AI; at least four days per month plus a monthly workshop. International expansion is not promised, but you can still express interest.
leads.eligibilityNote: The pilot expects in-person work in the US (reported); you can still express interest

leads.title: OpenAI Researcher Access Program
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. API credits for research on safety, societal impact and responsible deployment; reported to require an academic, research or nonprofit affiliation.

leads.title: Anthropic Fellows Program
leads.summary: Lead from research notes, not verified. Research tracks including AI safety, security, ML systems and reinforcement learning. Do not assume eligibility from Sweden.
